name: Santa on State
when_note: Friday, November 27, noon to 3 PM; Saturday, November 28, 2 to 4 PM; Saturdays and Sundays December 5, 6, 12 and 13, and Saturday, December 19, 3 to 6 PM
paras: Santa on State sets up Santa's workshop in a decorated storefront window at 127 State St., Suite 104, in downtown Madison, steps from the Overture Center and the Capitol Square.

Seven afternoon sessions run in 2026: Friday, November 27, noon to 3 PM; Saturday, November 28, 2 to 4 PM; Saturday and Sunday, December 5 and 6, and December 12 and 13, 3 to 6 PM; and Saturday, December 19, 3 to 6 PM. There is no cost to attend, and families bring their own camera or phone for photos.
tip: Bring your own phone or camera for the photo.

name: Santa Photos at West Towne Mall
when_note: Daily November 27 to December 24, 2026; Monday to Saturday noon to 7 PM and Sunday noon to 6 PM through December 10; Monday to Saturday 11 AM to 8 PM and Sunday noon to 6 PM from December 11
paras: Santa is at West Towne Mall in Madison from Friday, November 27, through Thursday, December 24, 2026.

Through December 10 the hours are noon to 7 PM Monday through Saturday and noon to 6 PM Sunday. From December 11 to 17 the hours are 11 AM to 8 PM Monday through Saturday and noon to 6 PM Sunday. Photo packages start at $40 through VIP Holiday Photos.
tip: Visit on a weekday for shorter lines.

name: Santa's Wonderland at Cabela's in Sun Prairie and Richfield
host: Cabela's Sun Prairie and Cabela's Richfield
address: Cabela's stores in Sun Prairie and Richfield, WI
when_note: Through December 24, 2026; Sundays 10 AM to 5 PM, other days 10 AM to 8 PM, Christmas Eve 10 AM to 5 PM
cost: Free 4 by 6 photo and video; photo packages $20 to $25
paras: Cabela's Santa's Wonderland offers free photos with Santa at its Wisconsin stores, including Sun Prairie near Madison and Richfield near West Bend, from Sunday, November 8, through Thursday, December 24, 2026.

Every visit includes a free 4 by 6 photo and a free shareable video. Photo packages are sold for $20 to $25. Hours are 10 AM to 8 PM on weekdays and Saturdays, 10 AM to 5 PM on Sundays and 10 AM to 5 PM on Christmas Eve. Visits can be scheduled online ahead of time.
tip: Schedule a time online before you go.

name: Cave of Lights at Cave of the Mounds
address: 2975 Cave of the Mounds Rd., Blue Mounds, WI
when_note: Daily from Thanksgiving through January 31, 9 AM to 5 PM, tours from 10 AM, last tour at 4 PM; closed December 24 and 25
cost: Included with a regular cave tour
paras: Cave of the Mounds in Blue Mounds, about 25 miles west of Madison, becomes a glowing underground holiday display during its annual Cave of Lights festival. The festival runs from Thanksgiving through January 31.

The cave is open seven days a week from 9 AM to 5 PM, with tours beginning at 10 AM and the last tour entering at 4 PM. It is closed Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve and Christmas Day. No special tickets are required because every tour in the festival period includes the Cave of Lights.
tip: Any tour time works because the lights stay on all day.

name: Home for the Holidays at Old World Wisconsin
when_note: Saturdays and Sundays, December 5 and 6 and December 12 and 13, 2026, 10 AM to 3 PM
cost: Tickets sold online; wagon rides cost extra
paras: Home for the Holidays at Old World Wisconsin in Eagle runs December 5 and 6 and December 12 and 13, 2026, from 10 AM to 3 PM, with Victorian holiday traditions at the historic outdoor museum.

Families visit a 19th-century Santa's workshop, ride a horse-drawn wagon (an additional ticket is required), make handmade ornaments and letters to Santa, meet Christmas folklore characters, pose with the Julblock straw goat, vote in a gingerbread house contest and listen to live music. Dress warmly because many activities are outdoors.
tip: Buy tickets ahead and dress warmly for the outdoors.

name: Breakfast with Santa at Old World Wisconsin
address: Clausing Barn, W372 S9727 Highway 67, Eagle, WI
cost: Ages 13 to 64 $52, seniors $40, children 5 to 12 $27, children under 5 $5
paras: Old World Wisconsin hosts Breakfast with Santa in the Clausing Barn on December 5, 6, 12 and 13, 2026, from 9 to 11 AM.

The meal is a buffet with French toast, eggs, bacon and pastries, and each child gets a gift at a meet and greet with Santa. The ticket also includes the Home for the Holidays experience, with horse-drawn wagon rides and an 1800s village with bonfires. Prices are $52 for ages 13 to 64, $40 for seniors, $27 for children 5 to 12 and $5 under age 5. Registration is required.
tip: Register early since this breakfast needs a separate ticket.

name: Brunch with Santa at the Ingleside Hotel
when_note: Saturday and Sunday, December 19 and 20, 2026, 9 AM to 1 PM
cost: $45 adults, $25 children 12 and under, plus a 22 percent service fee
paras: The Ingleside Hotel in Waukesha serves Brunch with Santa in the Lake Country Ballroom on Saturday and Sunday, December 19 and 20, 2026, from 9 AM to 1 PM.

The buffet has pancakes, an omelet station, chicken parmesan, maple glazed ham, garlic mashed potatoes and desserts. Kids get a photo with Santa, arts and crafts and cookie decorating. Cost is $45 for adults and $25 for children 12 and under, and a 22 percent service fee is added. Reservations are made on the hotel site.
tip: Reserve ahead on the hotel site.

name: Pet Photos with Santa at The Downtown Dog Spot
paras: The Animal Wellness Center hosts pet photos with Santa at The Downtown Dog Spot in Waukesha on Saturday, November 28, 2026, from 11 AM to 4 PM. The event is free.

Every visitor gets a printed photo that day, with a digital copy within two weeks, a voucher for a complimentary pet health check, a holiday moments tote, and coffee, cocoa and sweet treats. Reserve a spot on the Animal Wellness Center page.
tip: Reserve a time slot before you go.

name: Photos with Santa at the Big Bend Village Library
address: W230 S9185 Nevins St., Big Bend, WI
paras: The Big Bend Village Library hosts Photos with Santa on Tuesday, December 1, 2026, from 5 to 6 PM.
Children read with Santa, drink hot chocolate and take a photo with him. Registration is required through the library calendar.
tip: Register on the library calendar first.

name: Breakfast with Santa in Cedarburg
address: W67 N866 Washington Ave., Cedarburg, WI
when_note: Saturday, December 5, 2026, seatings at 9 AM and 11 AM
paras: The Cedarburg Juniors host Breakfast with Santa at The Ozaukee Pavilion on Saturday, December 5, 2026, with seatings at 9 AM and 11 AM.

The morning has a hot pancake breakfast, a Santa visit, shopping at Secret Santa's workshop, a letters to Santa station and raffle prizes. Tickets are $16 for adults and $11 for children 1 to 10, and children under 1 are free. Registration is required.
tip: Register for a seating ahead of time.

name: Santa's Workshop in Cedarburg
address: W63 N645 Washington Ave., Cedarburg, WI
when_note: November 27, 5 to 8 PM; November 28 and December 5 and 19, 11 AM to 2 PM; December 11 and 18, 4 to 7 PM; December 21, 5 to 8 PM
paras: Santa and Mrs. Claus make multiple appearances at Santa's Workshop, a life-sized gingerbread house with twinkling lights, a cozy fireplace and shelves of toys, outside the Cedarburg Community Gym.

Visits are free and first come, first served, and families can sign up for same-day slots 15 minutes before the workshop opens. Dates are Friday, November 27, 5 to 8 PM, when Santa and Mrs. Claus walk through Cedarburg; Saturday, November 28, December 5 and December 19, 11 AM to 2 PM; Friday, December 11 and 18, 4 to 7 PM; and Monday, December 21, 5 to 8 PM.
tip: Sign up for a same-day slot 15 minutes before opening.

name: Santa at the Pebble House in Port Washington
host: The Pebble House, Port Washington Visitors Center
address: 126 E. Grand Ave., Port Washington, WI
when_note: Saturday, November 28, noon to 2 PM; Friday, December 4, 5 to 7 PM; Saturday, December 12, noon to 3 PM; Saturday, December 19, 10 AM to 1 PM
paras: Santa visits the Pebble House at the Port Washington Visitors Center each week between Thanksgiving and Christmas, on Saturday, November 28, noon to 2 PM, Friday, December 4, 5 to 7 PM, Saturday, December 12, noon to 3 PM and Saturday, December 19, 10 AM to 1 PM.
The visits are free, with sweet treats, hot cocoa and a mailbox for mailing a letter to Santa.
tip: Pick a Saturday and mail a letter to Santa.

name: Christmas on the Corner in Port Washington
cost: See Visit Port Washington for details
paras: Christmas on the Corner fills downtown Port Washington on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 2 to 6:30 PM.

There are horse-drawn carriages, visits with Santa and his reindeer, cookie decorating and Christmas crafts, with window displays and the annual tree lighting. A parade and a fireworks finale close out the day.
tip: Stay for the parade and fireworks finale.

name: Breakfast with Santa in Thiensville
paras: The Thiensville Fire Department hosts Breakfast with Santa on Sunday, December 6, 2026, from 8 AM to noon at 250 Elm St.
The meal is all you can eat pancakes with photos with Santa. Cost is $8 for adults and $6 for children 6 to 10.
tip: Come hungry for the all you can eat pancakes.

name: Enchantment in the Park
address: 800 N. Main St., West Bend, WI
when_note: Nightly November 27 to December 24, 2026, 5 to 9 PM, Saturdays 6 to 9 PM; Santa visits Sunday, December 6, 5 to 8 PM
cost: Suggested minimum donation of $20 plus non-perishable food
paras: Enchantment in the Park is a holiday lights walk or drive through Regner Park in West Bend, open nightly from Friday, November 27, through Thursday, December 24, 2026.

Hours are 5 to 9 PM, with Saturday nights from 6 to 9 PM. Visitors enjoy horse and carriage rides, live music and fire pits, and Santa Claus visits on Sunday, December 6, from 5 to 8 PM. A minimum donation of $20 is suggested, and non-perishable, non-glass food items are collected for Washington County food pantries.
tip: Bring a food donation for the county pantries.
